tool.name: list_remote_computers
tool.description: 列出已登记计算机与非敏感连接标识。把返回的 id 原样用于 computerId 参数查询状态；配置存在不保证主机在线。

tool.name: get_remote_computer_status
tool.description: 查询一个已登记计算机的 SSH 可达性及托管 MCP 服务状态。computerId 从计算机列表复制；SSH 在线不等于硬件可操作。

computerId.description: Copy computerId from list_remote_computers; not a hostname or SSH command.

tool.name: list_mcp_servers
tool.description: 列出已登记 MCP 服务、所绑定硬件及连接状态。用于选择 serverId 与识别公开工具来源；服务登记或连接成功不代表目标电路通过测试。

tool.name: get_remote_mcp_service
tool.description: 刷新一个已登记 MCP 服务的进程和连接状态。用于核对启动、停止或重启结果；unknown 表示尚无法确认，不应解释为停止或成功。

serverId.description: Copy serverId from list_mcp_servers; one service binds one managed hardware object.

tool.name: start_remote_mcp_service
tool.description: 按已配置生命周期启动服务，可能初始化设备和驱动。serverId 从服务列表复制。超时不代表未启动；先查询状态再决定下一步。

serverId.description: Copy serverId from list_mcp_servers; one service binds one managed hardware object.

tool.name: stop_remote_mcp_service
tool.description: 按服务的正常关闭流程停止 MCP 服务，可能应用设备安全状态并断开硬件。操作前核对活跃运行；成功与安全收尾结果分别检查。

serverId.description: Copy serverId from list_mcp_servers; one service binds one managed hardware object.

tool.name: restart_remote_mcp_service
tool.description: 按已配置的正常关闭与启动流程重启 MCP 服务。可能改变设备会话和输出配置；超时后先查询状态，避免重复重启。

serverId.description: Copy serverId from list_mcp_servers; one service binds one managed hardware object.

tool.name: read_remote_mcp_logs
tool.description: 读取指定 MCP 服务最近的日志，lines 默认200、范围1–2000，用于服务故障诊断。

serverId.description: Copy serverId from list_mcp_servers; one service binds one managed hardware object.

lines.description: Most recent service log lines, default 200, range 1–2000.

tool.name: list_managed_hardware
tool.description: 列出平台管理的主动硬件及当前健康状态。用于选择 hardwareId；健康状态和执行资源可用状态应分别检查，不能由登记成功推断设备可用。

tool.name: list_hardware_catalog
tool.description: 列出本地登记的主动/被动硬件定义、端口和引脚。用于查接线资料，不会测量设备。调用接线工具时复用规范端点引用，不自行拼接 ID。

tool.name: get_hardware_definition
tool.description: 按 hardwareId 读取一份硬件定义及端口/引脚资料。区分厂商资料、人工录入和实时观测；本工具不验证实物版本或当前跳帽状态。

hardwareId.description: Copy the exact hardwareId from the hardware catalog; do not infer it from a label.

tool.name: save_hardware_definition
tool.description: 创建或更新一份本地硬件定义。影响目录和画布引用，不操作实物。必须按硬件定义 schema 提交；修改已有端口/引脚 ID 前检查关联接线。

formatVersion.description: formatVersion in the hardware record; preserve the schema type and existing identifier values.

hardwareId.description: Copy the exact hardwareId from the hardware catalog; do not infer it from a label.

label.description: Human-readable label; IDs, not labels, identify hardware.

kind.description: Hardware category: managed devices belong to an MCP service; passive objects contain local reference data.

serverId.description: Copy serverId from list_mcp_servers; one service binds one managed hardware object.

computerId.description: Copy computerId from list_remote_computers; not a hostname or SSH command.

portId.description: Exact local portId in the hardware definition, not the canonical endpointRef. Omit for the hardware image.

name.description: Optional human-readable run name; defaults to entrypoint filename stem.

pinId.description: Stable local pin identifier copied into wiring pin pairs.

position.description: position in the pins record; preserve the schema type and existing identifier values.

label.description: Human-readable label; IDs, not labels, identify hardware.

pins.description: Explicit pin mapping; a belongs to portA and b to portB. Empty is permitted only for different ports.

imageAssetId.description: Existing managed image asset identifier; use image tools to create or remove images.

ports.description: Physical connector definitions. Preserve stable IDs already referenced by wiring.

appearanceAssetId.description: appearanceAssetId in the hardware record; preserve the schema type and existing identifier values.

hardware.description: Complete local hardware definition matching this schema. This does not modify physical hardware.

tool.name: remove_hardware_definition
tool.description: 删除指定硬件的本地定义及关联图片。不会卸载驱动或移除实物；删除前核对工程引用，检查返回结果。

hardwareId.description: Copy the exact hardwareId from the hardware catalog; do not infer it from a label.

tool.name: set_hardware_image
tool.description: 为硬件外观或指定端口设置 PNG/JPEG/WebP 图片。imageBase64 是图片编码，portId 使用目录中的原值；此动作只修改资料图片。

hardwareId.description: Copy the exact hardwareId from the hardware catalog; do not infer it from a label.

portId.description: Exact local portId in the hardware definition, not the canonical endpointRef. Omit for the hardware image.

imageBase64.description: PNG/JPEG/WebP bytes as base64 or a data URL; the entire gateway request is limited to 1 MiB.

fileName.description: Original image filename used as metadata/format hint, not a path to read.

tool.name: remove_hardware_image
tool.description: 移除指定硬件外观图或端口图；省略 portId 时作用于硬件外观图。不会删除硬件定义或改变物理接线。

hardwareId.description: Copy the exact hardwareId from the hardware catalog; do not infer it from a label.

portId.description: Exact local portId in the hardware definition, not the canonical endpointRef. Omit for the hardware image.

tool.name: add_managed_hardware_to_canvas
tool.description: 幂等地将已登记主动硬件加入当前工程画布，已存在时返回 added=false。会改变工程未保存状态；不创建物理接线或测量结果。

hardwareId.description: Copy the exact hardwareId from the hardware catalog; do not infer it from a label.

tool.name: request_wiring_task
tool.description: 创建人工 connect/disconnect 接线待办，返回 wiringTaskId 和状态；本调用不移动任何线缆。端点和 pinId 必须来自目录的规范引用。确认后更新项目连接记录，待办本身属于应用会话。

hardwareId.description: Copy the exact hardwareId from the hardware catalog; do not infer it from a label.

portId.description: Exact local portId in the hardware definition, not the canonical endpointRef. Omit for the hardware image.

portA.description: Copy ports[].endpointRef from get_hardware_definition, or supply exact hardwareId/portId. Same-port wiring needs distinct pin pairs.

hardwareId.description: Copy the exact hardwareId from the hardware catalog; do not infer it from a label.

portId.description: Exact local portId in the hardware definition, not the canonical endpointRef. Omit for the hardware image.

portB.description: Second canonical endpointRef or structured endpoint; same-port loopback is allowed for distinct pins.

a.description: Exact pinId on portA, copied from that port's pins list.

b.description: Exact pinId on portB, copied from that port's pins list.

pins.description: Explicit pin mapping; a belongs to portA and b to portB. Empty is permitted only for different ports.

action.description: connect or disconnect requests human work; it never moves a cable automatically.

timeoutMs.description: Pending wiring task expiration in milliseconds; default 1800000, range 1000–86400000. Does not expire work already in progress.

tool.name: cancel_wiring_task
tool.description: 取消尚未完成的接线待办。取消待办不会撤销已经插好的线，也不会自动断开已确认连接；检查返回的当前状态。

wiringTaskId.description: ID returned by request_wiring_task; valid only in this application session.

message.description: Optional reason recorded on the task; cancellation does not undo physical wiring.

tool.name: get_wiring_task
tool.description: 读取本应用会话中的一个接线待办。返回状态、到期时间和结果；confirmed 是人工确认记录，不是电气测量。重启后任务可能不存在。

wiringTaskId.description: ID returned by request_wiring_task; valid only in this application session.

tool.name: list_wiring_tasks
tool.description: 按状态列出当前会话最近的接线待办，limit默认100、最大500。列表为空不代表工程没有已保存连接；已有连接应查询 get_project。

status.description: Filter by the exact lifecycle status; a successful program exit is not a test verdict.

limit.description: Maximum records in this response; use pagination or a narrower filter for more.
